title: Passenger Facilities Modernization at Gabtoli Inter-District Bus Terminal
description: The project involved digital surveying and comprehensive improvement planning for Gabtoli Bus Terminal, addressing existing traffic congestion and operational bottlenecks. Prepared detailed architectural floor plans for modern ticket counters, comfortable passenger waiting lounges, sanitary facilities, drainage systems, and optimized pedestrian walkways.
overview: Comprehensive modern passenger terminal facility planning, digital topographic survey, and structural engineering design under Dhaka North City Corporation.
challenges: Severe operational congestion during peak transit hours
Sub-optimal passenger circulation and inadequate waiting amenities
Complex drainage integration into existing Dhaka municipal stormwater network
approach: Conducted millimeter-precision digital survey across the entire terminal apron
Designed segregated ticket counter zones, multi-tier waiting lounges, and dedicated passenger walkways
Engineered heavy-duty RCC stormwater drainage network with palisading and retention
results: Complete architectural drawings and structural engineering models
Optimized bus and passenger circulation layout eliminating major gridlock points
Comprehensive BOQ, BOM, and tender documentation delivered on schedule

title: Road Improvement Works on Gulshan-Badda Link Road (Progati Sarani Corridor)
description: Road infrastructure improvement works under Dhaka North City Corporation along the critical Gulshan-1 to Progati Sarani corridor. Scope included geometric road alignment, construction of RCC medians, drainage network, pedestrian walkways, passenger shelters, and installation of durable drop palisading.
overview: Urban arterial road geometry restructuring, passenger waiting infrastructure, and drainage redesign along high-density corridor in Dhaka.
challenges: Extremely high live traffic volume during survey and alignment execution
Severe waterlogging during monsoon along link road intersections
Constrained right-of-way with high commercial encroachment
approach: Detailed corridor topographic mapping using RTK GNSS and robotic stations
Engineered RCC covered storm drains with integrated pedestrian walkways
Designed modern weather-resistant passenger waiting shelters and durable medians
results: Eliminated water stagnation along the corridor through gravity-fed RCC drainage
Enhanced pedestrian safety and bus passenger comfort with modern shelters
Delivered complete cross-sections, pavement design, and BOQ schedules

title: Passenger Facilities Modernization at Mohakhali Inter-District Bus Terminal
description: Comprehensive digital surveying, structural engineering, and passenger facility modernization at Mohakhali Inter-District Bus Terminal. Included dedicated AC and Non-AC ticket counters, modern waiting lounges, upgraded restrooms, RCC perimeter stormwater drains, palisading, and internal roadway improvements.
overview: Upgradation of one of Dhaka’s busiest inter-district transport hubs with modern ticketing facilities, sanitary amenities, and heavy drainage infrastructure.
challenges: Continuous 24/7 bus operations during digital survey and engineering study
Runoff drainage deficiency leading to pavement deterioration
Overcrowded informal ticketing structures blocking emergency passageways
approach: High-precision digital surveying to map exact boundaries and existing utilities
Architectural floor plans separating AC and Non-AC ticketing wings
Engineered heavy-load RCC box drains and slope protection palisading
results: Approved architectural floor plans and structural engineering designs
Robust perimeter drainage layout safeguarding terminal pavement life
Full tender-ready BOQ, specifications, and construction schedules

title: LTP of Sanitary Landfill at Moheshkhali Solid Waste Management
client: Local Government Engineering Department (LGED) / OSMO CORPORATION
description: The project involved the structural design and preparation of complete engineering drawings for the Leachate Treatment Plant (LTP) under the Moheshkhali Solid Waste Management initiative, safeguarding coastal groundwater and surrounding delicate ecosystems.
overview: Structural engineering design and hydraulic calculations for an advanced Leachate Treatment Plant at Moheshkhali Sanitary Landfill.
challenges: Highly corrosive leachate environment requiring chemical-resistant reinforced concrete design
Coastal saline subsoil conditions demanding specialized foundation engineering
Strict zero-leakage environmental compliance standards
approach: Finite element structural analysis for reinforced concrete retaining basins and tanks
Selected sulfate-resistant cement and specialized concrete cover specifications
Generated complete structural reinforcement schedules and fabrication details
results: Fully certified structural drawings for all LTP holding and treatment cells
Hydraulic design accommodating peak monsoon precipitation volumes
Full BOQ and structural construction specifications delivered to LGED

title: Pilot Research Project for Irrigation Water Management (WEB-AIS)
description: The WEB-AIS pilot research project aims to improve irrigation water management and agricultural productivity using spatial data. Survey activities included canal distribution mapping, TBM establishment, Land Use / Land Cover (LULC) classification, and multispectral NDVI vegetation health calculation across major agricultural command areas.
overview: Integrated web-based agricultural information system and field geospatial survey optimizing canal irrigation distribution across Manikganj.
challenges: Extensive, fragmented canal command networks across rural terrain
Need for seasonal vegetation vigor tracking to optimize irrigation delivery
Establishing unified geodetic TBMs across vast agricultural acreage
approach: Tied field survey to Survey of Bangladesh geodetic benchmarks using static GNSS
Detailed canal alignment and cross-sectional profile surveys
Processed multi-spectral satellite imagery to map LULC and compute NDVI vegetation health indices
results: Comprehensive irrigation canal distribution GIS maps and geodatabase
Precise canal slope profiles enabling gravity-assisted water distribution planning
Multi-seasonal NDVI baseline reports assessing crop health and water efficiency

title: Installation of Water-Level Gauge Readers & Topographic Survey at Gangarampur
description: The project involved the installation, calibration, and adjustment of river water level gauge readers at three critical river locations in Gangarampur under BADC. Topographic surveys were conducted alongside river level monitoring to understand seasonal flow variations and riverbed scour dynamics.
overview: Precision hydrographic water-level gauge installation and riverine topographic survey for surface irrigation planning under BADC.
challenges: Dynamic tidal fluctuations and high river velocity during monsoon gauge setting
Precise benchmark datum transfer across wide river banks
Ensuring structural stability of gauge posts against floating debris and current
approach: Established permanent TBMs on reinforced structures on both river banks
Installed durable, graduated water level gauges calibrated to national PWD datum
Conducted topographic cross-sections of river approach channels and banks
results: Accurate, real-time river stage monitoring infrastructure in place
Topographic contour surveys of riverbanks and adjacent irrigation inlets
Standardized hydrological data stream for BADC irrigation intake management

title: Abdulpur Railway Bypass Topographic & UAV Photogrammetry Survey
description: The Abdulpur Railway Bypass Project under subproject 2 of Railway Connectivity Improvement Preparatory Facility (RCIPF) involved high-precision topographic surveying and RTK-enabled drone photogrammetry. Generated millimeter-accuracy DSM, DTM, orthomosaics, 0.25m interval contours, and land use classification to support bypass rail alignment design.
overview: High-precision corridor photogrammetry and ground RTK survey for landmark railway bypass engineering under Bangladesh Railway.
challenges: Strict accuracy requirements for track geometry and turnout alignments
Active rail operations requiring strict safety protocols during aerial and ground surveys
Complex terrain with dense vegetation requiring multi-layer filtering for true ground DTM
approach: Deployed RTK-enabled multirotor drone with surveyed ground control points (GCPs)
Processed imagery into high-density 3D point cloud and extracted bare-earth DTM
Generated 0.25m contour models and detailed right-of-way topographic maps
results: Sub-centimeter accurate 3D digital surface and terrain models (DSM/DTM)
High-resolution orthomosaics covering the entire railway corridor
Civil 3D alignment files accepted directly by international consulting engineers (OCG)

title: Bus Route Rationalization & Arterial Corridor Concept Design
description: Preparation of Concept Design & Implementation Plan for Bus Route Rationalization and Corridor Improvement. Survey activities included classified manual traffic count surveys, UAV-based corridor photogrammetry, topographic survey, and digital surface modeling (DSM) to restructure public bus transit operations.
overview: Multi-modal urban transport study integrating drone corridor photogrammetry, traffic surveys, and geometric concept design across major Dhaka corridors.
challenges: Dense, chaotic urban corridor traffic with high pedestrian and vehicular friction
Restricted airspace requiring rigorous CAAB safety protocols and early morning flight windows
Integrating complex multi-junction turning movement counts with high-res spatial data
approach: Executed coordinated dawn UAV photogrammetry missions along key arterial corridors
Conducted 16-hour classified video and manual traffic volume surveys at critical junctions
Built high-resolution digital surface models and corridor cross-sections
results: Complete corridor orthomosaics and 3D terrain elevation models
Junction geometry and dedicated bus lane concept design layouts
Comprehensive traffic flow and corridor capacity analysis report delivered to DTCA
